entries.requirement: Article 30(2)(b): identify service and data locations and require advance notification of intended location changes.
Article 30(2)(f): require assistance for related ICT incidents at no extra cost or a cost fixed in advance.
Article 30(3)(a): for the assumed critical or important function, require full service levels with quantitative and qualitative targets and corrective action.
Article 30(3)(e): require the specified monitoring, access, inspection, audit, cooperation and copy rights; assess confidentiality arrangements without blanket exclusion.
Article 30(2)(d): cover access, recovery and return of personal and non-personal data in an accessible format on the listed disruption or termination events.
Article 30(3)(f): for the assumed critical or important function, provide an adequate mandatory transition period for continuity and migration.
